free_parameters.name: num_kv_heads
free_parameters.why: witness does not name the KV head count; fixed at 1 so the post-target gqa assertion cannot fail before the GPU kernel and the target decision does not depend on it

free_parameters.name: block_idx_head_width
free_parameters.why: the witness trigger and contrast both report len(block_idx[0]) == 2; the inner head-list width must stay 2 while num_q_heads is the single factor that changes

free_parameters.name: block_idx_last_width
free_parameters.why: default last-row head width equals the first row for the main pair; the extra negative lowers it to 1 so block_idx[0] and block_idx[-1] are distinguishable and the 0->-1 mutant is not equivalent

free_parameters.name: seed
free_parameters.why: fixed seed for reproducibility; tensors are zeros so the RNG is not otherwise used

free_parameters.name: grid_offset
free_parameters.why: function default, not part of the asserted guard; kept fixed for both inputs

free_parameters.name: softmax_scale
free_parameters.why: function default; only used after the target line in the GPU kernel path

free_parameters.name: gqa_interleave
free_parameters.why: function default; block_idx is supplied directly, so the GQA layout is irrelevant to the target decision

execution.entry_reason: The asserted value is block_idx, which is not a parameter of the official entry flex_prefill_attention: the entry builds it internally with get_active_blocks, which always returns exactly [batch_size, q.shape[2]] lists (transform_veritcal_slash_idx iterates range(q.shape[2])) and then passes it to the target unchanged. So len(block_idx)==batch_size and len(block_idx[0])==num_q_heads is an internal invariant and the target assertion cannot fire through flex_prefill_attention. Making the head counts non-divisible does not help: get_active_blocks fails earlier, before the target, on the q/k einsum/view shapes. The drivers still call the real target function with a real caller-supplied block_idx list; only the entry depth moves from call_chain[0] to call_chain[1] so the asserted block_idx width can be varied. This is why D14 stays residual and cannot be eliminated without mocking code before the target.
